text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through the Twinkle Series
with my partner Umamusume would begin.
The name of the girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I'm Silence Suzuka.
It's nice to meet you.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I wouldn't really call it a "dream," but...
Um, let's see...
I do love seeing that beautiful scenery from the front of the pack.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...The weather is so nice today.
Um, would it be okay if I went for a run?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, our challenge for the Twinkle Series
with <chrname> began!
